## Purpose and Entry Points
Cognee is a Python AI-memory platform: it turns documents, code, integrations, and session activity into persistent graph/vector-backed memory, then retrieves grounded context for agents. Primary programmatic entry points are the package and CLI at `cognee/__init__.py`, `cognee/__main__.py`, and `cognee/cli/_cognee.py`. HTTP operations are organized as FastAPI-style v1 routers under `cognee/api/v1/`, notably `cognee/api/v1/remember/remember.py`, `cognee/api/v1/recall/recall.py`, and `cognee/api/v1/cognify/cognify.py`.

## Ingestion and Memory Construction
The write path accepts text, binary/S3-backed content, directories, and structured sources. Ingestion identifies/classifies inputs and persists source data through `cognee/modules/ingestion/identify.py`, `cognee/modules/ingestion/save_data_to_file.py`, and `cognee/tasks/ingestion/ingest_data.py`. Loaders normalize text/code/media using `cognee/infrastructure/loaders/LoaderEngine.py`; chunking produces stable document chunks via `cognee/modules/chunking/incremental_chunking.py` and `cognee/tasks/documents/extract_chunks_from_documents.py`.

## Pipeline Orchestration and Cognification
Pipelines model runs, tasks, per-item status, progress, and errors. The orchestration boundary is `cognee/modules/pipelines/operations/run_pipeline.py`, with execution in `cognee/modules/pipelines/operations/run_tasks.py` and persisted run state in `cognee/modules/pipelines/models/PipelineRun.py`. Cognify routes and recovers graph-building work in `cognee/modules/cognify/routing.py` and `cognee/modules/cognify/recovery.py`. Dataset queues and locks serialize competing work at `cognee/infrastructure/databases/dataset_queue/queue.py` and `cognee/infrastructure/locks/dataset_lock.py`.

## Graph, Vector, and Provenance Stores
Extracted entities, relationships, summaries, and embeddings become graph/vector records. LLM graph extraction is implemented in `cognee/tasks/graph/extract_graph_from_data.py`; storage writes/indexes records through `cognee/tasks/storage/add_data_points.py` and `cognee/tasks/storage/index_data_points.py`. The storage abstraction separates graph, vector, relational metadata, cache, and unified backends: `cognee/infrastructure/databases/graph/graph_db_interface.py`, `cognee/infrastructure/databases/vector/vector_db_interface.py`, and `cognee/infrastructure/databases/unified/unified_store_engine.py`. Provenance tracks source-to-memory lineage and enables scoped deletion via `cognee/modules/provenance/manager.py` and `cognee/infrastructure/databases/provenance/write_context.py`.

## Retrieval and Recall
Recall/search selects a retrieval strategy, queries graph/vector/session context, and returns results with evidence. The central dispatch is `cognee/modules/search/methods/search.py`; retriever selection is `cognee/modules/search/methods/get_search_type_retriever_instance.py`. Major strategies include hybrid retrieval in `cognee/modules/retrieval/hybrid_retriever.py`, graph completion in `cognee/modules/retrieval/graph_completion_retriever.py`, and temporal retrieval in `cognee/modules/retrieval/temporal_retriever.py`. API-level recall also supports streaming through `cognee/api/v1/recall/recall_stream.py`.

## Agent Sessions, Improvement, and Integrations
Session memory is a faster stateful layer that can be distilled into durable graph memory. Session lifecycle and context construction reside in `cognee/infrastructure/session/session_manager.py` and `cognee/infrastructure/session/session_context_builder.py`; durable enrichment tasks are registered in `cognee/memify_pipelines/memify_default_tasks.py`. Agent-facing integrations are plugin-based, with OAuth/credential handling under `cognee/modules/integrations/oauth_flow.py`; Slack, GitHub, and Linear adapters live in `cognee/modules/integrations/slack/adapter.py`, `cognee/modules/integrations/github/adapter.py`, and `cognee/modules/integrations/linear/adapter.py`.

## Deployment Surfaces and External Dependencies
The core runtime is Python 3.10–3.14; containers are defined by `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, and `entrypoint.sh`. A Next.js frontend provides dataset, graph, search, session, integration, and tenant management workflows from `cognee-frontend/src/app/layout.tsx` and `cognee-frontend/src/app/(app)/datasets/DatasetsPage.tsx`. An MCP server exposes agent tools separately via `cognee-mcp/src/server.py` and `cognee-mcp/src/tool_registry.py`. Supported infrastructure includes local/S3 file storage, Redis/SQL/filesystem caches, Postgres/Turso relational storage, graph engines such as Kuzu, Ladybug, Neo4j, and Neptune, and vector engines such as LanceDB and PGVector. LLM/embedding providers are mediated by `cognee/infrastructure/llm/LLMGateway.py`, with adapters for OpenAI-compatible services, Ollama, Bedrock, Gemini, and others.
